page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz with 128 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration integrates 256.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is supported through a baseline network bandwidth interface of 64 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Operating with no local disk capacity necessitates external block storage for operating system drives and persistent application data. This diskless configuration isolates storage requirements from compute infrastructure, enabling flexible scaling of network volumes. From a cost efficiency perspective, dedicating hardware resources to a dense 128-core setup with a 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation prevents expenditure on unnecessary memory capacity for compute-bound tasks. The high 64 Gbps baseline network capacity mitigates network contention during intensive cluster communications or data transfer routines.

The ecs.c7.32xlarge is structured for parallel processing tasks requiring substantial CPU allocation and high network throughput without extreme memory capacity. Typical workload alignments include multi-threaded batch compute pipelines, software build systems, continuous integration processes, video transcoding, distributed analytics worker nodes, and dense web serving architectures.
